About Verisys

Founded 1997 in Reston, Virginia.  |  NASDAQ: VRSY  |  2,400+ employees worldwide

OUR MISSION

EMPOWERING THE GLOBAL ENTERPRISE

Verisys Enterprise Solutions exists to empower Fortune 1000 organizations through reliable, scalable software infrastructure that integrates mission-critical business processes across heterogeneous IT environments. We deliver measurable return on investment through proven J2EE technology, world-class professional services, and an unwavering commitment to customer success.

COMPANY TIMELINE — A HISTORY OF INNOVATION
YEARMILESTONE
1997Verisys Founded. Robert J. Chen and three former Oracle engineers incorporate Verisys Enterprise Solutions, Inc. in Reston, Virginia, with seed funding from Sequoia Capital and NEA.
1998VeriSuite 1.0 Released. First commercial release of the VeriSuite ERP platform. Signs first Fortune 500 customer, Prudential Financial.
1999IPO on NASDAQ. Verisys completes initial public offering on October 12, 1999 under ticker symbol VRSY. Opens European headquarters in Reading, United Kingdom.
2000VeriCore J2EE Platform. Launches industry-first J2EE-native application framework. Achieves 187% year-over-year revenue growth.
2001Acquired DataLogix Corp. Completes $284M cash-and-stock acquisition of DataLogix Corp., adding data warehousing capabilities now branded as VeriVault.
2002APAC Expansion. Opens regional offices in Tokyo, Singapore, and Sydney. Achieves ISO 9001:2000 certification across all engineering operations.
2003Launched VeriSuite 7.2. Latest release delivers Sarbanes-Oxley compliance reporting, enhanced .NET interoperability, and 99.999% uptime SLA. Named to Gartner Leaders Quadrant.

RC

Chairman & CEO
Co-founder. Formerly VP Engineering, Oracle Corporation. M.S. Computer Science, Stanford.

Chief Financial Officer

Industry-Specific Solutions

Pre-configured VeriSuite implementations for your vertical.

SOLUTIONS BY INDUSTRY VERTICAL

Verisys delivers domain-tailored implementations of VeriSuite 7.2 for the most demanding regulated industries. Each industry solution includes pre-built process templates, data models, and integration adapters certified by leading systems integrators.

FINANCIAL SERVICES
🏦

Straight-through processing, AML compliance, and trade analytics for global banks and asset managers.

"VeriSuite reduced our trade reconciliation cycle by 64% and gave us a real-time view across 18 trading desks."
— CIO, Northern Trust Corporation
» Read the Case Study (PDF)
HEALTHCARE
✚

HIPAA-compliant patient data integration, claims processing, and clinical workflow management.

"Verisys helped us consolidate 23 legacy systems into a single member services platform serving 8.4M lives."
— VP IT, Kaiser Permanente
» Read the Case Study (PDF)
MANUFACTURING
⚙

Lean supply chain, MES integration, and discrete/process manufacturing planning at global scale.

"Inventory carrying costs are down 22% and our supplier on-time delivery improved 31 points."
— SVP Operations, Archer Daniels Midland
» Read the Case Study (PDF)
GOVERNMENT
🏛

FISMA-certified, Section 508-compliant solutions for federal, state, and defense agencies. GSA Schedule 70.

"The VeriCore J2EE Platform satisfied our most stringent DoD security requirements without customization."
— Program Manager, Lockheed Martin IS&GS
» Read the Case Study (PDF)
RETAIL
🛒

Multi-channel merchandising, POS integration, and customer loyalty analytics across thousands of stores.

"We deployed VeriFlow BPM across 1,247 stores in under nine months — on time and on budget."
— CTO, National Retail Group (Fortune 100)
» Read the Case Study (PDF)
INSURANCE
📈

Policy administration, claims management, and actuarial data warehousing for P&C and life carriers.

"Underwriting cycle time fell from 6 days to 11 hours after our VeriSuite deployment."
— SVP Technology, Prudential Financial
» Read the Case Study (PDF)

REGULATORY COMPLIANCE ACCELERATORS

Verisys includes pre-built accelerator packs that dramatically reduce time-to-compliance for the regulations governing your industry. All accelerators are validated by Deloitte & Touche LLP.
✓ HIPAA
PHI protection, audit trails, role-based access, and EDI 837/835 transaction support out of the box.
✓ SARBANES-OXLEY
Section 302 & 404 controls, segregation of duties, and automated SOX certification workflow.
✓ FDA 21 CFR PART 11
Electronic signatures, validated audit trails, and GxP-ready system documentation templates.
